features.name: Powerful Build
features.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

features.name: Loxodon Serenity
features.description: You have advantage against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC equals 11 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. The Constitution modifier added to this AC can't exceed +5. You can use this AC if armor you wear would give you a lower AC, and you can still gain the benefit of a shield.

features.name: Trunk
features.description: You can grasp things with your trunk, and you can use it as a snorkel. It has a reach of 5 feet, and it can lift a number of pounds equal to five times your Strength score. You can use it to do the following simple tasks: lift, drop, hold, push, or pull an object or a creature; open or close a door or a container; grapple someone; or make an unarmed strike. Your DM might allow other simple tasks to be added to that list of options. It can't wield weapons or shields or do anything that requires manual precision, such as using tools or magic items or performing the somatic components of a spell.
